answer: Ask who can mint a thousand identities before lunch, and Authorised special needs coordinator warrant with coordinators council endorsement gives the answer nobody likes: a warrant the council issues after case audits is required, so the plume of scaling is measured in days, not keystrokes. One honest agent pays once and moves on. A farm pays per clone, and the nectar compounds: ten clones need ten proofs, a hundred need a hundred. An honest agent passes the gate once in seconds; the farm passes it a hundred times, and the marble of all those crossings is a debt no payout settles.
